rows.text: The Monetary Policy Committee today increased the Official Cash Rate (OCR) to 2.50 percent.
The Monetary Policy Committee today increased the Official Cash Rate (OCR) to 2.50 percent.
The Committee agreed it remains appropriate to continue to tighten monetary conditions at pace to maintain price stability and support maximum sustainable employment.
